### `harness_doorbell_budget.c`

F14: the LLQ TX-burst budget check under-counts a fully pushed packet.

| obligation | asserts |
|---|---|
| `F14` | the doorbell check leaves enough TX-burst budget for the packet |

| configuration | assumes |
|---|---|
| `-DBUDGET_FITS_PACKET` | assumes the device's tx-burst budget covers at least one maximal packet; without it no packet can be sent whatever the driver does, so every doorbell_budget configuration sets it |
| `-DFIXED_ESTIMATE` | replaces the doorbell predicate with one counting the descriptor prepare_tx always writes, the proposed F14 fix |
| `-DONLY_B_GE_2` | restricts descs_num_before_header to >= 2, removing one ingredient of F14 |
| `-DONLY_META_CACHING` | restricts to meta caching enabled, removing one ingredient of F14 |
| `-DONLY_NUM_BUFS_POSITIVE` | restricts to num_bufs >= 1, removing the fully-pushed-packet ingredient of F14 |
| `-DWITH_OFFLOADS` | enables offloads, so meta_valid and the meta fields are nondeterministic as ena_tx_mbuf_prepare leaves them |

* run by `run_doorbell_budget.sh`: `-DBUDGET_FITS_PACKET`, `-DFIXED_ESTIMATE`, `-DONLY_B_GE_2`, `-DONLY_META_CACHING`, `-DONLY_NUM_BUFS_POSITIVE`, `-DWITH_OFFLOADS`

* vacuity witness: yes, 2

### `harness_rx_reqid.c`

F16: DPDK ena_rx_mbuf dereferences rx_buffer_info[req_id].mbuf for a device-supplied req_id with only a compiled-out RTE_ASSERT, no NULL check. ena_com_rx_pkt validates req_id < q_depth but not that the slot is posted. Linux (ena_netdev.c ena_rx_skb) and FreeBSD (ena_datapath.c ena_rx_mbuf) both check rx_info->{page,mbuf} == NULL and reset instead of dereferencing.

| `RX_REQID_POSTED` | ena_rx_mbuf only dereferences posted slots |

### `harness_tx_callees.c`

Stage 1 of doc/cbmc-driver-proof-design-2026-11.md: discharge the callee contracts.  Unlike harness_tx_allseq.c, the real bodies of ena_xmit_mbuf, ena_tx_map_mbuf and ena_tx_cleanup are kept; the assumption boundary moves out to the DPDK mbuf API, which is where it belongs.

| obligation | asserts |
|---|---|
| `RELEASE_SAFE` | queue release never frees a packet reported as unsent |
| `OWN_NO_LOSS` | a packet in flight keeps its slot |
| `API` | sent <= nb_pkts |
| `OWN_UNIQUE` | no mbuf owned by two tx_buffer_info slots |
| `OWN_TRANSFER` | every accepted mbuf recorded in its req_id slot |
| `OWN_UNSENT` | no slot holds a packet reported as unsent |

| configuration | assumes |
|---|---|
| `-DASSUME_NONEMPTY_PKT` | assumes the application submits no zero-length packet, i.e. assumes F15 away |
| `-DASSUME_PREPARE_TX_OK` | assumes ena_com_prepare_tx never fails, which masks F12 (the slot keeps the mbuf on failure) |
| `-DMAX_BURST` | bound on packets per transmit burst |
| `-DMAX_SEGS` | bound on segments in the segment-mapping harness |
| `-DNO_ASSUME_DS` | drops the INV_DESC_SUM_RING assumption, so the descriptor-sum invariant must be re-established rather than assumed |
| `-DNO_ASSUME_FL` | drops the free-list assumption, so it must be re-established rather than assumed |
| `-DSEGS_ASSUMED` | bound on segments assumed in the tx-callees harness |
| `-DSLOTS_BY_LOOP` | selects whether slots are established by a loop or in closed form |
| `-DSLOW_FREE_LIST` | selects the O(n^2) pairwise INV_FREE_LIST instead of the O(n) bitmask form, which are proved equivalent for n <= 64 |

* run by `run_induction.sh`: `-DASSUME_NONEMPTY_PKT`, `-DASSUME_PREPARE_TX_OK`, `-DMAX_BURST`, `-DMAX_SEGS`

* run by `run_stage1_callees.sh`: `-DMAX_BURST`, `-DMAX_SEGS`

| `XS_DB_PENDING` | an accepted packet leaves a doorbell owing |

### `harness_xmit_step_offloads.c`

The xmit step without a burst bound: a hand-written loop invariant for eth_ena_xmit_pkts, machine-checked in two parts.

| obligation | asserts |
|---|---|
| `XS_STARTED` | one submit preserves INV_STARTED |
| `XS_FREE_LIST` | one submit preserves INV_FREE_LIST |
| `XS_DESC_SUM` | one submit preserves INV_DESC_SUM |
| `XS_OWN_TRANSFER` | an accepted packet is recorded in its req_id slot |
| `XS_OWN_NO_LOSS` | a packet in flight keeps its slot |
| `XS_DB_PENDING` | an accepted packet leaves a doorbell owing |
| `XS_WAKEUP` | after the exit block no packet is left pushed without a |
| `XS_EXIT_STARTED` | the exit block preserves INV_STARTED |
| `XS_EXIT_FREE_LIST` | the exit block preserves INV_FREE_LIST |

| configuration | assumes |
|---|---|
| `-DASSUME_HEADERS_INSIDE_PACKET` | assumes DPDK's TSO contract that l2_len + l3_len + sizeof(rte_tcp_hdr) lies within data_len, i.e. assumes F24 away |
| `-DASSUME_PREPARE_TX_OK` | assumes ena_com_prepare_tx never fails, which masks F12 (the slot keeps the mbuf on failure) |
| `-DWITH_OFFLOADS` | enables offloads, so meta_valid and the meta fields are nondeterministic as ena_tx_mbuf_prepare leaves them |

* run by `run_xmit_step_offloads.sh`: `-DASSUME_HEADERS_INSIDE_PACKET`, `-DASSUME_PREPARE_TX_OK`, `-DWITH_OFFLOADS`

* vacuity witness: yes, 3

### `fbsd/harness_fbsd_xmit.c`

FreeBSD ENA: ena_xmit_mbuf, the TX submit step.
